lines.zh: 我裹着布，一步步从沙里出来。
lines.en: Wrapped in cloth, I step out of the sand.
The sand goes cold where I walk.

lines.zh: 我的脚上没有鞋，只有布。
lines.en: No shoes on my feet, only cloth.
I walk toward the pyramid.
My arms lift very slowly.

lines.zh: 每一步，都像隔了几千年。
lines.en: Each step feels like several thousand years.

lines.zh: 我从石棺边走过，没有回头。
lines.en: I pass the sarcophagus without looking back.
I know the pictures on the walls.
I climb up the tomb passage.

lines.zh: 沙子从我的布里漏出来。
lines.en: Sand leaks from my wrappings.
I stop in the doorway and see the sky.
Too bright. I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我身上的布条被风掀起一角。
lines.en: The wind lifts a corner of my bandages.
There's nothing under the wrappings.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸棺盖上的刻文。
lines.en: I run my fingers over the carvings on the coffin lid.
There's still a ring on the finger bone.
I remember this weight.

lines.zh: 沙从墓道口流进来，埋住我的脚。
lines.en: Sand pours in from the tomb mouth and buries my feet.
I wait for someone to open the coffin.

lines.zh: 那面墙上刻着我的名字。
lines.en: My name is cut into that wall.
It can't be read anymore.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口墓里的干气。
lines.en: I breathe out the tomb's dry air.
The breath is dry.

lines.zh: 我数着墓室顶上的裂缝。
lines.en: I count the cracks in the tomb ceiling.
I like it this way.
But someone always comes.

lines.zh: 我把手指张开了，又合上。
lines.en: I spread my fingers, then close them.

lines.zh: 墙上有一条裂缝，一直通到顶。
lines.en: A crack in the wall runs all the way up.
You opened what shouldn't be opened.
There were seals on that sarcophagus.
You dug it open.
So here I stand.
I wear a king's wrappings.
You're the first to see them.
I should thank you.
But I must follow the old rules.
Whoever breaks into the tomb stays.
I raise a hand and you'll step back.
Good. You did.
None of it will help you.
My curse doesn't need to touch you.
There's sand on you already.
A length of my wrappings is torn.
A handful of dry sand spills from my wrappings.
I slowly wind them back.

lines.zh: 这一下，浪费了我几百年。
lines.en: That cost me a few hundred years.
I step back and my joints creak.
Pain. Real pain.
I raise my hand to show you.
Black seeps through the cloth.
I am truly angry now.

lines.zh: 几千年没人让我生气了。
lines.en: No one has angered me in millennia.

lines.zh: 放下那把铲子，这墓里不缺土。
lines.en: Put down that shovel; this tomb has soil enough.

lines.zh: 这个年代的东西，都太小。
lines.en: Everything from this age is too small.

lines.zh: 我见过金子，比这多得多。
lines.en: I've seen gold. Far more of it.
Put it down. I won't touch it.
Open the sarcophagus and I wake.
I want you to stay here.
Stay here forever.
The tomb needs a keeper.
I've kept it a long time.
Time for a new keeper.
You bump into me. I'm light.
Sand spills from my wrappings.
That left your arm numb.
I raise a hand and you back two steps.
My hem brushes your leg.
That spot will stay cold a long while.

lines.zh: 我的裹布擦过你，沙粒落下。
lines.en: My wrappings brush you and sand trickles down.
You're still standing there — I can wait.
Then you're mine.
The tomb door has closed.
I had a queen once.
She's in another chamber.
I haven't gone to find her.
Because only one seal was broken.
I've waited here a few thousand years.
So has she.
We're in no hurry.
Time means little to us.
You, on the other hand, are in a hurry.
Hurrying will do you no good.
I pick up a golden cup.
This is mine. It always was.
An eagle is carved on it.

lines.zh: 这枚圣甲虫要放回棺里。
lines.en: This scarab belongs back in the coffin.
Nothing may be out of place.
I pick up an amulet.
That's for the dead.
You're still alive. You don't need it.
I'll put it away for you.
You'll want it later.
There are prints in the sand.
Fresh. The wind hasn't smoothed them.
I follow the prints.
They lead to the tomb entrance.
You're inside the tomb now.
I raise a hand and the door opens.
You turned and saw me.
This place will do nicely.

lines.zh: 你手上的铲子还在滴沙。
lines.en: Sand still drips from your shovel.
Not fast, and no need to be.
I never need to be fast.
You'll reach the end on your own.
I'm the one who closed that door.
The key is with me.
I follow you like a shadow.
Cloth-wrapped feet make no sound.

lines.zh: 你每转一次头，我就慢一点。
lines.en: Each time you turn, I slow.

lines.zh: 我伸手，沙顺着墙缝往下流。
lines.en: I reach out and sand pours down through the wall seams.
The passage is long. You can't run it all.

lines.zh: 墓道的墙上没有第二扇门。
lines.en: There is no second door in these tomb walls.
I know. I built it.
You're looking for a mechanism in the wall.
That brick is a fake.

lines.zh: 我抬手，沙从上面落下来。
lines.en: I raise a hand and sand pours down.
You're buried to the waist.
No incantation needed for this.

lines.zh: 只是这地方本来就是我的。
lines.en: This place was always mine.
This ground obeys me.

lines.zh: 你的脚踝已经被沙埋住一半。
lines.en: Sand has already buried half your ankle.
I raise a hand and a curse goes out.

lines.zh: 它打在你胸口，没有声音。
lines.en: It hits your chest without a sound.
Your lips are going white.
I raise my hand again.
Closer this time.
Your knees have given out.
I walk over, very slowly.
My wrappings drag through the sand.
I lay a hand on your head.

lines.zh: 这个动作，我做过很多次。
lines.en: I've done this many times.
The sarcophagus lid is pushed aside.
Sand flows in first.
Then one of my hands.
I sit up and my joints creak.
The air here is drier than in the tomb.

lines.zh: 我从沙里撑起身体，布条绷紧。
lines.en: I push myself up out of the sand, my wrappings taut.
I haven't stood in a few thousand years.
My wrappings are still new.
I see light, from the passage mouth.
And I see you.
You're still holding a shovel.
You dug me up.
Congratulations on digging me up.
And my condolences to you.
My wrappings catch fire, fast.

lines.zh: 我从石阶上摔下去，骨头散了。
lines.en: I fall down the steps and my bones scatter.

lines.zh: 水灌进布里，我重得走不动。
lines.en: Water soaks my wrappings and I'm too heavy to move.

lines.zh: 炸响把墓室掀开，我被埋了。
lines.en: The blast opens the chamber and buries me.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的胸口，没有血。
lines.en: An arrow goes into my chest. No blood.
That spell is older than I am.

lines.zh: 墓里没有供奉了，我很空。
lines.en: No offerings left in the tomb. I'm empty.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，布全焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and my wrappings char.
I fall where there is no sand.
